In 1942, Carol’s mother, who was a nurse, was taken prisoner by the Japanese and imprisoned as an inmate at a POW camp in Sumatra. Her mother was eventually repatriated to Ireland but sadly lost her husband. Carol and her sister were evacuated to stay with a friend of their mother’s, in Ireland, where they were subsequently interned for a year and a half as enemy aliens. About ALICE…
Alice Torriani
Artist, Cook, Housewife, Mother…She came to America at the age of 24, following her husband of seven years. Arriving in Philadelphia on August 16, 1889, Alice was one of the women who did the hard work of settling into a new life, without language, transportation, or experience. Three months later, when her marriage collapsed, Alice was left as a single woman with two sons and a pregnant daughter
